I haven't seen you before. Who are you? Identify yourself, or else...
Please lower your guard. Leo at the Temple of Seres sent me.
You're Rosemary, right? You came all this way to escort Iris...
You know quite a bit. Yes, I'm Rosemary...
Wait, you... Judging by your appearance, are you the one Lady Iris mentioned...? First, tell me how you got here. Clearly enough for me to understand.
strings.(지금까지 있었던 일을 로즈마리에게 전부 이야기한다. 여행의 시작부터 최: (I tell Rosemary everything that has happened, from the beginning of my journey to the recent events at the Temple of Seres.)
strings.믿을 수 없군. 신전을 습격한 마족 부대 우두머리 블라스를 쓰러뜨렸다는: Unbelievable. You're saying you defeated Blas, the leader of the demon force that attacked the temple? Then Leo sent you here...
And you did all that purely to meet Lady Iris.
strings.네, 맞아요. 이리스는 어디에 있죠?: Yes, that's right. Where is she?
strings.기다려. 난 지금 널 신뢰할 수 없어. 바로 이리스 님을 만나게 할 수도: Wait. I can't trust you yet. And I can't simply let you meet Lady Iris.
I'm not so easygoing that I'll trust someone I've just met.
strings.그래도 내가 널 도와주긴 할 텐데, 너 나와 일 하나 해야겠어. 좀 귀찮: Still, I will help you. But first, you'll have to do a job with me. It may be a little troublesome.
strings.이리스 님을 모시고 이스트랜드에 도착하긴 했는데, 일이 생겼거든. 이곳에: We reached the East Land with Lady Iris, but something happened. As soon as we arrived, of all times...
strings.이스트랜드 중심엔 루맨이라는 곳이 있어. 루맨은 빛의 연합이라는 이름으로: In the center of the East Land is a place called Lumen. Under the name Alliance of Light, it fights the evil that plagues the East Land.
strings.여기도 꽤 복잡해. 싸울 상대가 한둘이 아니거든. 하여튼, 그곳의 맹주: It's complicated here too. We have more than one enemy to fight. Anyway, their leader, a man named Ziskad who is called the Sword God, has ties to Demigod Frozen.
strings.프로즌 님은 이리스 님이 그곳에 가면 검신의 보호 아래 세레스 님께 받은: Lord Frozen decided that, under the Sword God's protection there, Lady Iris could settle more safely into the power she received from Lady Seres.
They say Lumen has a place where people with unusual gifts can train...
strings.뭐, 어쨌든 우리는 루맨으로 향하려고 준비를 하고 있었어. 그런데 타이밍: In any case, we were preparing to head for Lumen. Then, with spectacularly bad timing, someone attacked the Kingdom of Jude and cut off the road.
Lady Iris couldn't stay here, so Frozen took her ahead. I remained behind to assess the situation.
It's infuriating. I knew this wouldn't be easy, but why does it have to be like this? The beings from the demon realm pursuing Lady Iris are far too much for us to handle alone.
We've managed to hold out because of Lord Frozen... no, because of that man Frozen...
strings.이야기가 길어졌네? 이리스 님을 위한다면 내 일을 도와줘. 쥬드 왕국이: I've talked too long. If you care about Lady Iris, help me. If Jude falls, Lumen, where she will be staying, will be in danger too.
strings.우선 네 실력을 봐야겠다. 뭘 하면 될지는 알고 있겠지?: First, I need to see what you can do. You know what that means, don't you?
strings.보기보다 의외군. 그렇게 적들을 쉽게 해결할 줄은 몰랐어. 단순한 모험가: You're more surprising than you look. I didn't expect you to deal with those enemies so easily. I knew you weren't an ordinary adventurer, but this...
You pass for now. You seem qualified to protect Lady Iris.
Then let's get to the next task.
strings.쥬드 왕국 근처에는 많은 소수 민족 마을이 있어. 그 중엔 태양신 아그니: Many small tribal villages lie near the Kingdom of Jude. One clan counts the sun god Agni among its ancestors. They call themselves the Agni.
strings.원래 그들은 쥬드 왕국과는 별개의 세력으로 사막에서 용병일을 하면서 살아: They've always lived independently of Jude, working as mercenaries in the desert. As far as I know, their chieftain is even a friend of the King of Jude.
strings.어느 순간, 일족을 데리고 쥬드 왕국을 습격했어. 게다가 모스 왕국이라고: Then one day, he brought his clan to attack Jude. And there's the Kingdom of Moss... Ah, this is complicated. How much do I need to explain...?
strings.모스 왕국은 오래 전 프레이오스에 있던 왕국인데, 어쩌다보니 패배해서 이: Moss was a kingdom in Freios long ago. After a defeat, it ended up in the East Land. I suspect they may be acting at Moss's instigation now.
strings.하여튼, 아그니 족장이 쥬드 왕국 수도 메르타에 군사를 이끌고 들어와서: Anyway, the Agni chieftain led troops into Merta, Jude's capital, and threw it into chaos. Then he disappeared somewhere. We don't know where...
We've split up to search. Help us.
I don't know where he might be, but we have to find him and face him. What else can we do?
strings.그 자는 강한 적이야. 전투 용병 아그니의 중심에 있는 자니까 쉽진 않겠: He's a powerful enemy. He stands at the heart of the Agni fighting mercenaries, so it won't be easy.
strings.나도 그 자를 쫓아 싸우고 싶지만, 나는 이곳을 지켜야 해. 쥬드 왕국의: I'd like to pursue and fight him myself, but I have to guard this place. Jude's people have fled all the way to this border region, and we're short-handed.
strings.아그니 일족 말고 다른 적들도 있는 건가요?: Are there other enemies besides the Agni clan?
strings.이리스 님을 쫓는 자들이 한 둘이 아니란 건 알고 있겠지? 아마도 마족일: You know there are plenty of people after Lady Iris, don't you? They're probably demons.
Stay focused. This is a battlefield. If you lose concentration, anything could happen.
Anyway, let's hurry and find him.
strings.적장을 찾아내면 끝인가요?: Will it be over once we find the enemy commander?
strings.부디 끝이길 빌어야겠지, 안 그래?: We'll have to hope so, won't we?
strings.후우, 그나저나 쥬드 왕국의 경비대가 하고 있는 걸 보고 있으니 답답하군: Sigh. Watching Jude's guards is frustrating. We need to evacuate the civilians, so let's clear out the enemies right in front of us first.
So much to do. Sigh... I thought becoming a Battle Lord would make things a little easier...
Good. Very clean work. I can tell you have experience.
The way you handle enemies is far from ordinary. Phew.
I could trust you with Lady Iris, but there's still much to do.
strings.이제 적장을 찾으러 가면 되겠죠?: Now I should go find the enemy commander, right?
strings.서두르지 마. 무턱대고 가서 일을 그르치면 어떻게 하려고? 정보가 있어야: Don't rush. What if you charge in blindly and ruin everything? You need information.
strings.히솝이라는 자가 있을 거야. 겁쟁이처럼 벌벌 떨던 인간이지만, 그에겐 정: There's a man named Hyssop. He shakes like a coward, but he has information. He may seem incompetent, yet his intelligence network is what has kept him in his position.
Go ask him whether he has information on the enemy commander.
strings.경비 대장이라고 해서 이 상황에서도 대우를 해야 하나 조금 고민이 되는군: I wonder whether I really have to treat him with respect even now, just because he's captain of the guard. No helping it.
strings.수도 제대로 못 지켰다고 혼자 자책하고 있을 텐데, 적당히 상대해줘. 그: He'll be blaming himself for failing to defend the capital. Humor him a little, but don't stay too long.
All right. I'll keep that in mind.
strings.만약 널 의심한다면 내가 보냈다고 이야기 해. 그렇지 않으면…. 히솝의: If he doubts you, say I sent you. If that doesn't work... tell him I'll spread his secret far and wide. He'll understand. That should get him moving.
strings.표정이 왜 그래? 무슨 나쁜 인간 보는 것처럼…. 그래, 나도 잘 알고: What's with that look? You look as if you're staring at a villain... Yes, I know. It isn't a particularly admirable method...
strings.살기 위해서 어쩔 수 없이 습득한 방법이야. 지금은 그게 중요한 게 아니: But it's a method I had to learn to survive. That isn't what matters right now, so don't worry about it.
strings.어서 가, 시간이 없어. 나는 다른 일을 하고 있을 테니까!: Go. There's no time. I'll be taking care of other things!
strings.적을 처치하던 솜씨가 보통이 아니던데, 당신은 누굽니까?: Your skill at defeating those enemies was exceptional. Who are you?
Please, don't be alarmed. Rosemary sent me. So...
strings.(히솝이 경계를 풀지 않는 모습에 다시 한번 설득을 시도한다.): (Hyssop remains guarded, so I try to persuade him again.)
strings.아군인지 적군인지 의심스러운 자가 여기까지 와서 로즈마리 이름을 언급하는: Someone whose allegiance I don't know comes here and invokes Rosemary's name. Of course I have to be cautious.
So you do doubt me. Rosemary said that Hyssop's secret...
I don't know what it's about, so you can relax.
I accept that you're an ally. You needn't say anything more.
strings.그러면 제가 알려드리겠습니다. 일단 먼저 궁전 안을 살펴보시는 게 좋겠군: Then I'll tell you what I know. First, you should inspect the palace interior.
strings.으으, …그대는…. 그대는 누군가? 누구이기에 이런 힘을 가지고 있는 거: Urgh... You... Who are you? What kind of person possesses such power...?
strings.자, 잘 듣게…. 나는, 에이션트 엔트의 혼이 뒤섞여 있는 상태니 오래: L-listen carefully... My soul is mingled with that of an Ancient Ent. I won't be able to hold on for long. It's only your power that has allowed me to awaken now.
So I'll tell you what you wish to know. I am Darman, chieftain of the Kaim...
strings.저기, 쥬드 왕국을 침략한 이유가 뭔가요? 쥬드 왕국과 별 문제없이 지내: Why did you invade the Kingdom of Jude? I don't understand why the Agni clan, which lived peacefully alongside Jude, attacked either, but why did the Kaim...?
strings.이해가 되지 않아요. 모스 왕국의 사주를 받은 건가요?: I don't understand. Did the Kingdom of Moss put you up to this?
strings.대체 이곳에서 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 건가요?: What on earth is happening here?
strings.우리의 의지가 쥬드 왕국을 공격했다면 차라리 나을테지. 명분이라도 있을: It would have been better if we'd attacked Jude of our own free will. At least then we'd have had a cause.
strings.하지만, 그들은 힘없고 약한 일족의 아이들을 인질 삼아 협박했네. 그리고: But they took the weak, helpless children of our clan hostage and threatened us. They forced us to fight.
Every time we refused, they would... our children...
They did it because they knew their brainwashing wouldn't work on us.
strings.저, 저. 그러면. 인질이 된 사람들은 어떻게 된 거죠?: T-then... what happened to the hostages?
They will die. This happened because my virtue and resolve were lacking...
But this... this is too cruel. Surely...
strings.그대의 탓이 아니다. 자책하지 말게. 붉은 머리의 그들이 원흉이니…. 그: It isn't your fault. Don't blame yourself. Those red-haired ones are the cause... They wear human shapes, but they are not human.
strings.사막에 재앙을 몰고 온 자들, 그들이 이스트랜드로 넘어와 모스 왕국과 손: They brought calamity to the desert, crossed into the East Land, and joined hands with Moss. Moss must have had something it wanted too, to accept them.
strings.그들이 이 전쟁을 일으켜 취하려는 것이 있다. 그러니 그걸 막아주게. 아: There is something they mean to gain by starting this war. Stop them. The Agni chieftain was used as well. I'm not asking you to forgive him.
strings.그들을 막아주게. 더는 이스트랜드에 피바람이 불어선 안돼. 이미 모두의: Stop them. No more blood must be spilled in the East Land. We already have an enemy common to us all...
strings.붉은 머리의 그들이라면 반과 마라란 건가요?: By the red-haired ones, do you mean Ban and Mara?
My mind... is fading. I can no longer hear what you're saying...
Before my soul falls asleep... tell Agni... tell the people of Jude... that I was sorry...
strings.(다르만의 목소리가 더는 들려오지 않는다.): (Darman's voice can no longer be heard.)
strings.다녀오셨군요. 궁전의 내부는 어떻습니까?: You're back. What is the situation inside the palace?
strings.(궁전에서 있었던 이야기를 히솝에게 전한다.): (I tell Hyssop what happened in the palace.)
Moss and the two who caused all this took Darman's people hostage and threatened them...
strings.감상에 빠져있을 때가 아닙니다. 그들에게 사정이 있었다 해도 저희에겐 적: This is no time for sentiment. Whatever their circumstances, they are our enemies...
strings.그들은 우리를 공격했고, 우리는 큰 피해를 보았습니다. 그것이 사실입니다: They attacked us, and we suffered great losses. That is an unchanging fact.
Yes, I understand what you're saying.
strings.그곳에서 아그니 족장은 찾을 수 없었어요. 혹시 어디로 갔는지 아시나요?: I couldn't find the Agni chieftain there. Do you know where he went? Do you have any information?
You're in a hurry. Please calm down for a moment...
strings.병사들에 따르면 그가 태양신의 지하 제단 쪽으로 향했다고 합니다. 그곳엔: According to the soldiers, he headed toward the Sun God's underground altar. His Majesty should be there...
Wait. We can't just stand around here.
I've already hurried soldiers to Ballas, the palace guard at the underground altar. Please go and investigate.
strings.그에게 가면 자세한 정보를 들을 수 있을 겁니다. 저기 이야기를 다 듣고: He'll be able to give you detailed information. Wait, you should hear me out before...
Who are you? Ah, one of Rosemary's companions? The soldiers who arrived earlier told me about you.
I'm Ballas, a palace guard. I look forward to working with you.
strings.지금 저희는 이곳에 진입하려고 준비 중입니다. 하지만, 안이 복잡해서 조: We're preparing to enter, but the interior is complicated, so it may take some time...
strings.오래 걸린다고 머뭇거리는 건가요? 아니, 그 전에 궁정 경비대라는 사람이: You're hesitating because it will take time? No, more to the point, how can a palace guard say that...?
You couldn't help being ambushed, but this attitude is hardly appropriate now.
A retainer who doesn't even know whether the king, the ruler of his country, is alive...
strings.… 면목 없습니다. 제가 나약해서 일어난 일입니다. 그러니 절 탓해주셨으: ...I have no excuse. This happened because of my weakness. Please blame me.
Don't say that to an outsider like me. It's for His Majesty to judge... I... Sigh. I don't know anymore.
strings.(이런 생각은 하고 싶지 않지만, 쥬드 왕국의 인물들은 왜 다 이런 거지: (I don't want to think this way, but why is everyone in Jude like this? I'll go inside and look for the Agni chieftain.)
I have nothing to say. Take my head and present it to Jude's army.
strings.이상하군요. 왜 그렇게 체념하고 있는 거죠? 마치 이런 상황을 바라기도: How strange. Why have you given up so completely? Almost as if you wanted this to happen...
Darman, chieftain of the Kaim, said he was sorry for attacking.
Ah... I see. So that's it. I suspected as much, but still...
Cough, cough. W-wait a moment. I have something to say to him.
strings.폐하? 괜찮으신가요?: Your Majesty? Are you all right?
Yes, I am the King of Jude... I'm all right, so don't worry. Forgive me for asking this of someone I've just met, but please step back for a moment.
Thank you. You have my gratitude once again...
strings.(쥬드 왕국 국왕이 쓰러져 있는 아그니 족장을 바라본다.): (The King of Jude looks at the fallen Agni chieftain.)
strings.오랜만이야, 친구. 여전히 자네의 눈빛은 차디차군. 이제는 조금 풀 때도: It's been a long time, my friend. Your gaze is as cold as ever. Isn't it time you softened a little?
strings.여전히 농담을 받아주지 않는 것도 그렇고, 실력도 그렇고. 오래 전, 어: You still won't indulge my jokes, and your skill hasn't changed either. It reminds me of the difficult times we faced together long ago.
strings.태양신 아그니의 능력을 받은 자네는 역시 대단했지. 안그런가?: With the sun god Agni's power, you were truly extraordinary. Weren't you?
strings.한 마디라도 좀 해주게. 나 혼자만 떠들고 있지 않은가?: Say something, won't you? I'm the only one talking.
strings.자네는 대체 왜 모스 왕국의 편에 선 것인가? 왜 우리 왕국을 공격한 것: Why did you side with Moss? Why did you attack our kingdom? You were never like this before.
strings.게다가 왜 나를 죽이지 않고 내버려뒀나? 지금 자네의 입장에서 나는 적이: And why did you leave me alive instead of killing me? From where you stand now, I am your enemy.
strings.적을 죽이지 않고 내버려둔 건 분명 이유가 있을 것이고. 자네, 이 사막: There must be a reason you spared an enemy. Tell me what's happening in the desert. Tell me what has happened.
Only then can I keep my promise to you.
strings.자네가 어려울 때, 내가 자네의 일족을 거두기로 했던 걸 지금이라도 지키: I want to honor my promise to take in your clan when you were in trouble, even now. So please, tell me.
strings.그래, 이야기해주지. 모스 왕국에 어떤 이들이 찾아왔다. 그들은 마석이란: All right. I'll tell you. Some people came to Moss. They showed something called magic stones to its king and prince, then brainwashed the soldiers.
strings.그래서 모스 왕국 병사들이 나타나 사막의 소수 민족을 탄압했고, 그 과정: Moss's soldiers came and oppressed the desert's smaller tribes. In the process, many magic stones were spread around.
strings.소수 민족과 정령들이 세뇌에 당해 공격하기 시작했고, 우리는 최대한 버티: The tribes and spirits were brainwashed and began attacking. We tried to hold out as long as we could, but there were too many. We were defeated.
strings.카임 족과 우리 일족은 어쩔 수 없이 죽지 않기 위해 쥬드 왕국으로 들어: The Kaim and our clan had no choice but to enter Jude to avoid being killed...
strings.내가, 내 손으로 아그니 일족의 긍지를 이뤄냈다고 생각했는데, 내가 전부: I thought I'd established the Agni clan's pride with my own hands, but I destroyed everything... Even the sun god will not forgive me...
All because of those red-haired twins, a brother and sister, the continent has become like this...
Listen carefully. Moss will keep growing stronger.
strings.마석의 수를 늘려서 이 이스트랜드마저 집어삼킬 거라고!! 데이모스 교단이: They'll produce more magic stones and swallow even the East Land!! The Deimos cult may be waiting for just such a moment!!
strings.고맙네. 나머지는 나한테 맡기게. 무슨 일이든 잘 해낼테니까. 날 믿어주: Thank you. Leave the rest to me. I'll find a way, whatever happens. Trust me.
Now I'll tell you what will be done with you.
You'll spend some time in prison, reflecting on your actions.
strings.지, 지금 무슨 소리하는 거지? 날 살리겠다고? 난 죽어가고 있네. 당연: W-what are you saying? You intend to keep me alive? I'm dying. I deserve to die.
Otherwise, the people of Jude will never forgive it.
If I die, the hostages held by Moss can live.
strings.… 그걸 믿는 건가? 믿지 말게. 모스 왕국의 보이드 국왕과 녹스 왕자가: ...Do you believe that? Don't. Do you really think King Void and Prince Nox of Moss are men who would show mercy?
Good. You've made the right decision. I'll think of the best way forward.
strings.자, 이제 내 이야기는 모두 끝났네. 시간을 줘서 고맙군. 이제 돌아가: Now, I've said everything I needed to say. Thank you for giving me time. Let's return and report the situation. The tribes' attack has been brought to an end for now...
Your Majesty, are you all right? I, Ballas, was concerned for your safety...
strings.조용, 조용히 하게. 그동안 어디 갔나 했더니, 자네를 이곳에서 보다니: Quiet, quiet. I wondered where you'd gone. How good to see you here.
strings.자네, 다친 곳은 없나? 어째 그동안 얼굴이 더 좋아진 것 같군. 하하…: Are you injured anywhere? Somehow, you look even healthier than before. Haha...
M-my safety matters less than Your Majesty's...
strings.괜찮다고 몇 번 말하지 않나. 그건 그렇고 히솝은 어디에 있나?: How many times must I say I'm all right? More importantly, where is Hyssop?
strings.설마 전사한 것인가…?: Surely he hasn't fallen in battle...?
I see. I'll have to speak with Hyssop too.
I was quite all right a moment ago... but seeing you has made me tired.
strings.전하, 죽을 죄를 지었습니다. 경비대장이면서 사명을 제대로 다하지 못하고: Your Majesty, I have committed an offense deserving death. As captain of the guard, I failed in my duty and could not protect you...
strings.적의 공격에 맞서 싸우지 못하고 쓰러진 죄, 이 모든 것은 저의 불찰입니: I failed to withstand the enemy's attack and fell. All of it was my negligence.
strings.그만하게. 알았으니 이제 일어서고. 한 마디만 더 한다면 참았던 화를 낼: Enough. I understand, so stand up. One more word and I may lose the temper I've been holding back. Enough!
strings.(국왕의 이야기를 들은 히솝이 그제야 일어나 뒤로 물러난다.): (Only after hearing the king's words does Hyssop rise and step back.)
strings.이번 사태로 자네들도 깨닫는 바가 있겠지. 이제 자네들이 해야 할 일이: You must have learned something from this incident. There is much for you to do now.
strings.루맨에서도 우리에게 이런 일이 있었다는 걸 알고 있을 걸세. 적의 수장이: Lumen will know what happened to us. The enemy commander has fallen, but stragglers remain, so they'll send people.
strings.지금은 적의 도발에 응하지 말고, 최대한 버티는 방향으로 군을 운용하길: For now, don't rise to the enemy's provocations. Deploy our forces to hold out as best we can. The Alliance of Light will want the same...
strings.내가 이 모험가와 국경지대 페스토로 가서 바질 영주와 함께 방안을 마련하: I'll go with this adventurer to Pesto at the border and work out a plan with Lord Basil. Follow my instructions here.
strings.(정말 저 사람들을 믿어도 될까? 후우, 일단 폐하를 모시고 국경지대로: (Can I really trust these people? Sigh... For now, let's escort His Majesty to the border.)
Oh! Basil, my friend! Have you been well? It's all the better to see you after so long.
You're safe! What a relief! You must have endured so much.
I heard an adventurer had gone there to rescue you...
strings.그래, 이 친구 덕분에 살았네. 놀라운 실력을 지녔더군. 마음 같아서는: Yes. I survived thanks to this one. Such astonishing skill. I'd like to use every means at my disposal to keep this adventurer here...
But that would be selfish of me. Sigh... What can I do but blame my poor luck with people?
strings.멀리서 온 교단 사람들과 이야기하는 걸 보면 이 친구는 할 일이 있는 것: Judging by the conversations with the church members who came from far away, our friend has other business.
Next time, I'll make sure capable people can serve at your side.
You have a difficult time of it.
strings.하하, 괜찮네. 이번에 못했으면 다음에 더 잘 하면 되지 않겠나? 자네: Haha, it's all right. If we failed this time, we can do better next time, can't we? Thanks to you, we can protect this country.
strings.자네는 이 나라의 은인…. 자네의 공은 후세에 알려 칭송할 수 있도록 하: You are this country's benefactor... I will see that your deeds are recorded and praised by future generations.
Just as when the Sword God Ziskad saved everyone long ago.
It's all right. I didn't do anything quite that grand...
strings.(이제 이리스에 대한 이야기를 들을 수 있겠지….): (Now I should finally be able to hear about Iris...)
Thank you. I hope we meet again under happier circumstances.
strings.우리는 우리대로 더 나은 방법을 강구할 것이고, 주민들이 피해가 없도록: We'll keep looking for better solutions and make sure the people are protected.
Now that Moss has gained new power, I don't expect it to withdraw easily... It will keep using that power to cause trouble.
I'll take my leave now. Until next time.
What a relief. Seeing you back like this... I thought you'd manage without much trouble, but... Anyway, tell me how it all ended.
strings.(로즈마리에게 아그니 족장까지 만난 이야기를 전한다. 그리고 다.): (I tell Rosemary about meeting the Agni chieftain and everything else that happened.)
strings.그래? 아가슈라라고 하던 그 놈들이 모스 왕국과 붙어서 카임 족과 아그니: Really? Those Agasura joined forces with Moss and used the Kaim and Agni clans?
The Agasura are creating demons and supplying them to the kingdom...
strings.모스 왕국이야 원래 프레이오스에 있을 때부터 패권을 잡기 위해 발버둥치던: Moss has been struggling for dominance since it was in Freios. After being driven out and coming here, doing the same thing again is understandable enough.
The problem is those two. The ones who gave Moss the magic stones...
strings.악을 행하고 혼란을 일으킬 수 밖에 없는 운명을 가진 자들이라고 알고 있: I understand they're beings fated to commit evil and sow chaos...
strings.그 녀석들이 행하는 행동은 달라. 그저 개인적인 일을 하고 있다는 느낌이: But their actions feel different. It seems as though they're pursuing some personal matter.
Sigh. I don't know the details. Anyway, our work here is done...
Now go and pursue your own goal.
strings.이제 이리스 님을 만나러 가야지. 안 그래?: You need to go see Lady Iris now, don't you?
Hehe. Your expression finally brightened. Even if I'm not entirely happy about it, there's no helping it. It's our agreement with the church.
I received word that Lady Iris arrived safely in Lumen.
strings.(마음 속에 있던 답답한 기분이 날아가는 것 같아…. 나는….): (It feels as though the weight in my heart is lifting... I...)
It won't be long until we can meet now.
strings.그래, 일단 나는 여기서 할 일이 좀 더 있어서 같이 가지 못해. 그러니: Right. I still have work here, so I can't go with you. Head straight to Lumen.
strings.루맨은 쥬드 왕국 북쪽에 있는 화이트 콜 협곡을 지나서 갈 수 있어. 그: You can reach Lumen through White Col Canyon, north of the Kingdom of Jude. And...
